name: bag-of-holding
description: store your RPG party's inventory in the cloud

paragraphs: Bag of Holding is a web app that lets all the players in a tabletop RPG session track their inventory in one central location. Inventory sheets are created without requiring any account creation or authentication and update in real time, allowing for easy and convenient collaboration between players, as well as offering advanced filters and searching that makes it suitable for tracking both the group inventory and the inventory of individual players.

features: React, bootstrapped with Next.js via create-next-app and Chakra UI for styling
